description: AI companion for Paperless-ngx OR it's own document managment system: automatically titles, tags and files your documents, reads bad scans with local OCR (PaddleOCR, CPU/GPU) and answers questions about your whole archive with cited sources. Works with OpenAI, Claude, Ollama (fully local), Azure and any OpenAI-compatible API.
summary: An automated document analyzer for Paperless-ngx using OpenAI API, Ollama, Deepseek-r1, Azure and all OpenAI API compatible Services to automatically analyze and tag your documents.
